title: lockscreen
description: Lock screen (and the SDDM login theme that mirrors it): style, tone, layout and media.

position.title: Password field
position.description: Edge of the screen for the password field and media card.

x-settings.label: prefs.lockscreen.position
x-settings.keywords: lock screen password position top bottom edge

style.title: Lock screen style
style.description: Live previews with your wallpaper and palette. The SDDM login screen follows the same style.

x-settings.label: prefs.lockscreen.style
x-settings.keywords: lock screen style look glass paper sumi-e terminal crt aurora glacier neon tokyo poster koyo

tone.title: Tone
tone.description: Light or dark version of the style. Styles that only have one keep it.

x-settings.label: prefs.lockscreen.tone
x-settings.keywords: lock screen light dark tone mode theme

blur.title: Wallpaper blur
blur.description: How much the wallpaper behind the lock screen is softened.

x-settings.label: prefs.lockscreen.blur
x-settings.keywords: lock screen wallpaper blur soft background

showMedia.title: Now playing
showMedia.description: A media card with controls while music plays.

x-settings.label: prefs.lockscreen.show_media
x-settings.keywords: lock screen media music player now playing

showVisualizer.title: Audio visualizer
showVisualizer.description: Spectrum bars in the media card (uses cava while playing).

x-settings.label: prefs.lockscreen.show_visualizer
x-settings.keywords: lock screen audio visualizer cava bars spectrum

showStatus.title: Status strip
showStatus.description: Your name, network and battery along the edge.

x-settings.label: prefs.lockscreen.show_status
x-settings.keywords: lock screen status user network wifi battery
